vectors._why: ENCODING TRIPWIRE, added 2026-08-27. Rows 1-5 are all ASCII, where a string's UTF-8 byte length equals its JS code-unit length -- so they cannot tell the two apart. Mutating encodeField from bytes.length to value.length left all 18 original tests green while silently changing the key for every non-ASCII scope. These two rows close that hole: utf8Bytes(16) != codeUnits(10) here, and 12 != 6 below. Do not replace them with ASCII.
